title: Synchronous pdfplumber parse blocks the event loop in async handlers
fix: Wrap extract_pdf_text in await asyncio.to_thread(...) in both upload_resume and extract_pdf

title: Deleting or replacing a resume does not deactivate chat_memories resume entries; free_practice interviews keep recalling stale resume PII after deletion (erasure completeness)
fix: On save_resume/delete_resume, also deactivate memory_type='resume' rows in chat_memories (or read resume from user_resumes only)

title: Text-phase stream_llm_messages call omits max_tokens; OpenAI-compatible path sends no max_tokens so the provider default applies and may silently truncate the optimized resume
fix: Pass max_tokens=4096 (project convention) to stream_llm_messages in the text phase

title: optimize_resume_event_stream holds LLM orchestration, JSON parsing and persistence in the router, violating the routers-must-be-HTTP-only rule
fix: Move the generator to resume_service (e.g. optimize_resume_stream), router keeps only request parsing and StreamingResponse

title: Test gaps: no HTTP-level happy path for upload/delete/get metadata, no wrong-type position test, no dict-envelope points branch, no duplicate-upload race, no 50k truncation, no cross-user isolation, no stale chat-memory test
fix: Add the listed adversarial/edge tests per D3 critical-path matrix

title: Deleting the resume (with optimization history) is destructive and has no confirmation step
fix: Gate handleDelete behind a ConfirmDialog (project convention)

title: No UNIQUE(user_id) on user_resumes; invariant is app-enforced only (delete+insert in one transaction is currently race-safe, but a future refactor to upsert/skip-delete silently duplicates rows)
fix: Add UNIQUE index on user_resumes(user_id) as schema-level invariant

title: body is untyped dict; non-string position raises AttributeError -> 500; position length unbounded inflates prompt
fix: Use a Pydantic body model with position: str = Field(max_length=100)

title: save_optimization return value ignored; deleting the resume mid-stream still emits done claiming saved
fix: Check the return; yield error event when False

title: get_resume selects raw_text (up to 50KB) for a metadata endpoint that discards it
fix: Add lean get_resume_meta selecting id/filename/created_at only

title: points items are not validated as strings; a dict/list item renders as [object Object] in badges
fix: Coerce each point to str() in the router before yielding

title: Icon-only Trash2 button has no aria-label or AppTooltip, violating the project a11y convention (WCAG 4.1.2)
fix: Add aria-label="删除简历" or wrap in AppTooltip with text

title: In-flight optimize SSE is not aborted on component unmount; the fetch continues after leaving the page
fix: Pass an AbortController via postSSE options and abort in onUnmounted

title: Native select/checkbox/file input instead of shadcn Select/Checkbox components, deviating from the project design-system mandate
fix: Replace with shadcn Select and Checkbox components

title: except Exception swallows the root cause (pdfplumber crash) into a generic ValueError with no logging
fix: log the original exception before raising ValueError

title: user_resumes.updated_at column exists but is never written; dead schema weight
fix: Drop the column or set it in save_resume

title: 历史 tab 维度分解丢失：迁移后 /api/practice-history 恒返回 evaluation_result=None，PracticePanel 的维度/建议区不再渲染（新自测无完整评估展示）

title: _duplicate_payload 的 datetime.fromisoformat 无 try/except：存量非 ISO next_review_at 会 500（deck_service 的同名助手有 try/except，不一致）

title: ORDER BY uqr.updated_at 无 (user_id, updated_at) 索引，全量扫用户行排序
